title: "New axial–torsion testing equipment at EIIA-To"
date: 2026-07-13
description: "New experimental capacity at EIIA-To for combined axial and torsional mechanical loading."
categories: [Research infrastructure, Experimental mechanics, COMES]
image: ../../assets/photos/axial-torsion.jpg
---

The experimental capabilities available at EIIA-To have expanded with equipment for combined **axial–torsion mechanical testing**. The system complements the multiaxial and full-field experimental methods used in current work on composite materials and other structural materials.

![Axial–torsion testing equipment at EIIA-To.](../../assets/photos/axial-torsion.jpg)
